subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept the opt-in `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` knob that times out deferred turn maintenance and fences late side effects after timeout?
rationale: The code path is narrow and tested, but adding a new config/default surface and changing maintenance side-effect timing when enabled are maintainer product and compatibility choices.

options.title: Accept the opt-in knob
options.body: Land the PR after final exact-head validation because default-disabled behavior preserves upgrades while giving operators a bounded recovery path for #96703.

options.title: Keep the fix but change the surface
options.body: Ask for a different owner, name, or default policy if maintainers want the timeout controlled by recovery/session policy rather than compaction config.

options.title: Reject the config surface
options.body: Close or rework the PR if maintainers prefer to solve stuck maintenance only through existing recovery behavior without a new operator option.

recommendation.title: Accept the opt-in knob
recommendation.body: Land the PR after final exact-head validation because default-disabled behavior preserves upgrades while giving operators a bounded recovery path for #96703.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged/reviewed the background maintenance feature and are the strongest available owner for deciding the permanent config and lifecycle contract.
